title: Autopsy and Alibi
author: Freya Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Whitlock, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
